purpose: Teach: 和平/冥福/旺盛/平穏/献身/憎しみ/推論/分泌

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、和平活動への医療支援を医療チームで行っております
lines.en: Ren, we provide medical support for peace-building efforts through our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Even tone, professional but warm. No rush. The voice of someone accustomed to explaining serious work without grandstanding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: お亡くなりになった患者さんのご冥福を、貴院、お祈りされたとのこと、先生
lines.en: I heard your hospital offered prayers for the patient who passed away, Doctor.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly formal. Genuine curiosity underneath — Ren is testing the waters of what this doctor actually believes. Careful articulation. A question wrapped in respect.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、お子さんの食欲旺盛は健康の証ですね
lines.en: Yes — a child's appetite is a good sign of health, isn't it.
lines.style: Warm observation, almost gentle. Brief, because it's self-evident. The voice of someone who has seen this many times and still finds it reassuring.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 地域の平穏を守る医療体制を、貴院、整えておられますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has built a strong medical system to protect the region's wellbeing, hasn't it, Doctor.
lines.style: Quiet admiration. Not flattery — genuine recognition. Slower pace, like he's thinking aloud. Respectful but also searching for something deeper beneath her answer.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者さんへの献身的なケアを医療チームの誇りです
lines.en: Yes, dedicated patient care is something our medical team takes pride in.
lines.style: Direct, steady. A hint of warmth acknowledging Ren's insight. Professional but not distant. The word 'pride' lands clearly — this matters to her.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療への憎しみを抱える患者さんへ、貴院、丁寧に向き合われますね、先生
lines.en: You approach patients with real care, even when they come in with anger toward medicine itself, Doctor.
lines.style: Slow, deliberate. Ren recognizing something he's observed closely. Respectful but also slightly vulnerable — this matters to him too. Soft eye contact in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、症状からの推論を医療チームで行います
lines.en: Yes, we draw conclusions from symptoms as a team through careful observation.
lines.style: Steady, assured. A small shift toward the methodical — showing how rigor and care work together. Even tone, no condescension. She's meeting him on his level.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: ホルモン分泌の検査、貴院、専門ですね、先生
lines.en: Hormone testing is one of your hospital's strengths, isn't it, Doctor.
lines.style: Quiet recognition. Respectful closure — Ren is drawing the thread together. Slight trailing acknowledgment, like he's putting together something he understands now.
